5-Day Istanbul & Ephesus City and History Tour
summary:
The 5-Day Istanbul & Ephesus Tour combines two essential chapters of Turkey’s history without making the trip feel rushed. Spend three days in Istanbul exploring the historic Sultanahmet area, including Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace, and see the city from the water during a Bosphorus cruise. You will then fly to the Aegean region to visit Ephesus, where highlights include the Library of Celsus and the Great Theatre.
The tour can begin on the date that suits your travel plans, with adjustments available when required. Your package includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers, entrance fees and the guided sightseeing listed in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Half Day Bosphorus Cruise Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia on one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, return to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Ephesus from Istanbul by Roundtrip Flight
itinerary.text:
At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00.
Upon arrival at 08:10, meet your guide and continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the impressive Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the sacred House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. After the tour, transfer to Izmir Airport for your evening flight to Istanbul at 19:00. Upon arrival at 20:00, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your departure flight.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Istanbul & Ephesus Tour?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Istanbul & Ephesus Tour covers two of Turkey's most famous historical destinations: Istanbul and Ephesus. You will explore Istanbul's iconic landmarks, including Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar, before visiting the ancient city of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved archaeological sites in the world. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Istanbul & Ephesus Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €795 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 5-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights provide a convenient and time-saving way to travel between Istanbul and the Ephesus region, allowing you to spend more time exploring Turkey's historical attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 4 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers are included throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 5-day Istanbul and Ephesus tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural context, and local knowledge while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Turkey's rich cultural and historical heritage in a short amount of time. It combines the imperial history of Istanbul with the remarkable ancient ruins of Ephesus, creating a memorable introduction to Turkey.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 5-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, museums, and archaeological sites. Ephesus includes walking on uneven stone paths and gentle slopes, but most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Ephesus included in the tour?
faqs.a: The Ephesus tour includes visits to famous landmarks such as the Library of Celsus, the Great Theatre, Marble Street, the Temple of Hadrian, and the Temple of Artemis. Depending on the itinerary, the House of the Virgin Mary may also be included.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Istanbul & Ephesus Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 5-Day Istanbul & Ephesus Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights in Istanbul, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or adjust the itinerary to suit your travel style. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
